title: Deeala on Seaside Boardwalk

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Yo! You're not catching me on the best day. Look at the state of me. Again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yo! You're not catching me on the best day. Look at the state of me. Again.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I'm barely holding it together friend. I bet you can tell just looking at me what happened.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm barely holding it together friend. I bet you can tell just looking at me what happened.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: No, not yet. But my night job is IMPOSSIBLE because my landlord, Pilk Dane, keeps turning the heat off. Then on. Then off again.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, not yet. But my night job is IMPOSSIBLE because my landlord, Pilk Dane, keeps turning the heat off. Then on. Then off again.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Bingo bango! You got it. Pilk FUCKING Dane. Do you know him?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bingo bango! You got it. Pilk FUCKING Dane. Do you know him?

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: He's the worst landlord AND the worst comedian in Nivalis. When he raised rent, I said I couldn't afford it, so offered to give feedback on his standup routine instead.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's the worst landlord AND the worst comedian in Nivalis. When he raised rent, I said I couldn't afford it, so offered to give feedback on his standup routine instead.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I'm not sleeping, I can't afford decent food, and I'm uncaffeinated. And all because I couldn't stop myself from telling some arsehole landlord that he's as funny as a respiratory virus.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not sleeping, I can't afford decent food, and I'm uncaffeinated. And all because I couldn't stop myself from telling some arsehole landlord that he's as funny as a respiratory virus.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: That's not really my style. And I feel like you should know that about me at this stage in our relationship.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's not really my style. And I feel like you should know that about me at this stage in our relationship.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: Good. Cos you don't get a lot of layers of subtext with me. Never really mastered the filter on this mouth of mine.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Good. Cos you don't get a lot of layers of subtext with me. Never really mastered the filter on this mouth of mine.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I'm workin' on it. But right now, I gotta get going.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm workin' on it. But right now, I gotta get going.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: That's sweet of you to offer. But this is my fight. I've dealt with worse - much worse - than a landlord with delusions of comedy grandeur.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's sweet of you to offer. But this is my fight. I've dealt with worse - much worse - than a landlord with delusions of comedy grandeur.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I'm taking some food to Reese, my old colleague. He got fired, and now he's considering moving to the Ventz to escape the city.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm taking some food to Reese, my old colleague. He got fired, and now he's considering moving to the Ventz to escape the city.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: For most people - no. For Reese - double no. The kid wouldn't last the night in the Ventz. He's softer than that slime mold that slithers around the docks at midnight.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: For most people - no. For Reese - double no. The kid wouldn't last the night in the Ventz. He's softer than that slime mold that slithers around the docks at midnight.

nodes.speaker: Deeala
nodes.text: I'll help him out as best I can. And I'll see you around. Later friend.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'll help him out as best I can. And I'll see you around. Later friend.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You ok?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You ok?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You look good.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You look good.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You got fired from your job at the club?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You got fired from your job at the club?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You got fired from your job at the club?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You got fired from your job at the club?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Problems with your landlord again?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Problems with your landlord again?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn't Pilk Dane a comedian?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn't Pilk Dane a comedian?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is he trying to evict you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is he trying to evict you?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Is he trying to evict you?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Is he trying to evict you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You should just move.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You should just move.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's a terrible landlord then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's a terrible landlord then?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He's the comedian right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He's the comedian right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You'd be better off selling a kidney.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'd be better off selling a kidney.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You'd be better off selling a kidney.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You'd be better off selling a kidney.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You need to learn when to hold your tongue.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You need to learn when to hold your tongue.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You need to learn when to hold your tongue.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You need to learn when to hold your tongue.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I like that you say what you mean.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I like that you say what you mean.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I like that you say what you mean.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I like that you say what you mean.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you going to do about your bad landlord?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you going to do about your bad landlord?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What are you going to do about your bad landlord?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What are you going to do about your bad landlord?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can I help you deal with Pilk Dane?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can I help you deal with Pilk Dane?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can I help you deal with Pilk Dane?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can I help you deal with Pilk Dane?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What are you doing now?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What are you doing now?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Is that a good idea?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Is that a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I hope you can help him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I hope you can help him.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I hope you can help him.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I hope you can help him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: He needs to stand on his own two feet.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: He needs to stand on his own two feet.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: He needs to stand on his own two feet.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: He needs to stand on his own two feet.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I'm sure you know what you're doing.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure you know what you're doing.
